note: Requests that were stopped and are never resumed. Their request files and the raw containers they did produce stay exactly as written, and a container is read the same whether or not its request is listed here. What a stopped request still needed was planned again, from everything heard by then, under a new round id. Listing a request here is the only way a full run may be built while that request is unfinished.
